kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ينبهر (form VII)
# يَنْبَهِرُ (yanbahiru) /jan.ba.hi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# يَنْبَهِرَ (yanbahira) /jan.ba.hi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# يَنْبَهِرْ (yanbahir) /jan.ba.hir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
